### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**3** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/view.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **216** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **156** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **156**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **101** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8e505db8178cedbed174049b211cc409b22adaea` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `bf01f67849ebb3db8571bb36ec7dc97b0bca28f5` — the merge of head `6966a0b17784d89c8aa016f37b64d6aa417096a8` into base `8e505db8178cedbed174049b211cc409b22adaea`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin bf01f67849ebb3db8571bb36ec7dc97b0bca28f5 && git checkout bf01f67849ebb3db8571bb36ec7dc97b0bca28f5
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 8e505db8178cedbed174049b211cc409b22adaea 6966a0b17784d89c8aa016f37b64d6aa417096a8 && git checkout -B drift-repro 8e505db8178cedbed174049b211cc409b22adaea && git merge --no-ff 6966a0b17784d89c8aa016f37b64d6aa417096a8

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 8e505db8178cedbed174049b211cc409b22adaea
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b71e28d33c7a050a0d8b4f8847b81bbffa13a86d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/filter-rule-array.ts + packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts, packages/spec/liveness/view.json, packages/spec/src/ui/view-filter-or-group.test.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/filter-rule-array-guidance.test.ts, packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts, ui/packages/core/src/utils/filter-converter.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/viewFilterFold.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/widgets.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-view/src/config/view-config-utils.ts, ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx, ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridQueryInputs.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/viewFilterOrGroup.roundTrip-28370.test.tsx

Face: schema (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` is a published schema path). Inputs read: card #28522 body and all four comments (two triage posts, the claim, the os-dev report), PR #29534 body and nine-file list, the net diff against the merge-base `c88467d4` on `main` (9 files, +53 / −42, byte-identical to the file list), and the sixty-five check-runs on the head. The rest of the diff (the three generated `content/docs/references/ui/*.mdx` pages, the changeset, the two test pins, the liveness note) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`; the cited code was read, never reviewed.

Gate verdicts on the head, read off the check-runs: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Type Check UI`, `Test UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI` all `success`; `Lint UI` concluded `skipped` (no `ui/` path in the diff), a neutral conclusion, not a red; `Spec property liveness`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards` and `Build Docs` all `success`. No required context is red or in progress.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set: unchanged — right.** `ViewFilterOrGroupSchema` keeps its `strictObject`, its non-empty `or` array, its `{ or: [] }` refusal and its stray-key guidance; `ViewFilterElementSchema`'s union and `reportClaimedFilterElementBranch` are untouched; `ruleArrayFilterError` still refuses a top-level `$or` with `invalid_type` and the same first sentence. Only prose bodies move. The changeset's "the schema accepts and refuses exactly what it did" is true of the tree.
- **Public surface: the `.describe` text of `ViewFilterOrGroupSchema` changes — right, and fully regenerated.** The description ships in `dist`, `json-schema/` and `/meta/types`, and is projected into fifteen nested-shape blocks across `content/docs/references/ui/{component,page,view}.mdx` (every changed line in those three files is this one describe, nothing else). `check:docs` sits inside the green `TypeScript Type Check` job, so the committed projection matches the source. No export is added, removed or renamed, so no api-surface movement — right.
- **Runtime string: the `$or` refusal sentence in `filter-rule-array.ts` loses its parenthetical — right.** The sentence still names the any-of group element as the one spelling of `$or` over flat rules, still refuses to flatten, and carries no tracker number.
- **Register: `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` `props.list.children.filter.note` amended, status stays `live` — right.** The old note asked to be amended "citing the group read, when it lands"; the new note cites `toFilterNode` via `viewFilterOrGroupToNode`, the `ListView.tsx` `buildEffectiveFilter` path through `mergeFilterNodes`, `ObjectView.tsx`, the save fold and `builderRulesOfSpecFilter`, each of which I read on `origin/main` (below). The liveness gate is green.
- **Test pins: two re-pinned — right.** `view-filter-or-group.test.ts` now asserts the description starts with `An any-of group:` and carries no `[PLANNED`; `filter-rule-array-guidance.test.ts` drops the `no console applies it yet` assertion and keeps the any-of-group-element pin. Both pins hold the card's filing gate (the false status is gone), not merely the absence of a word.
- **Sibling copy of the same false status left in the package — wrong (omission).** `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`, function `dollarKeysReason`, lines 13930–13931 on this head, still reads "`$or` over flat rules only an any-of group element `{ or: [rule, ...] }` (declared, not yet applied by any console) that this conversion does not write". Judged in ④ as must-fix.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/28522-view-or-group-live.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': patch`, body carrying `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, no arm; the PR body carries the same two lines. Matches what the diff publishes: nothing an author can write changes (`none` ⇒ `patch` under the Post-Task Checklist's level rule), and `skip-changeset` would be wrong because the describe text ships in `dist` and `view.zod.ts` itself ships through the package's `files[]` (`src/**/*.zod.ts`). `Check Changeset` is green. No ADR-0087 disposition is owed (nothing retired, no conversion entry). Level and declarations: right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation 1 — `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` edited outside the claim's listed file surface: answered. The card's Wanted names it ("Any liveness / marker register row that lists this key as planned moves with it"), the edit is the amendment the old note itself requested, and ④ reads it. Accepted.
- Dev deviation 2 — PR template headings folded into the os-dev section order: a PR-body matter, not a tree matter; nothing to judge here. Not escalated.
- Dev deviation 3 — `main` merged before the PR opened (sixteen commits, including PR #29447's disjoint `view.zod.ts` hunks) and `view.mdx` regenerated from the merged tree: verified. `git diff` from the merge-base `c88467d4` to the head is exactly the nine listed files, and the `view.zod.ts` hunks are L1163–L1175 and L1214–L1223 alone.
- `open_questions`: empty in the report. None raised by this review beyond the ④ must-fix, which is a finding, not a question.
- The PR is still a draft; landing is the owning seat's act and outside this record.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` — holds against the code it cites; one imprecision noted.** Read on `origin/main`:

- "`toFilterNode` lowers a group to one `or` node of its rules, a child of the list's AND like any rule" — true. `ui/packages/core/src/utils/filter-converter.ts`: `toFilterNode` maps an array that `carriesViewFilterElement` through `lowerViewFilterElement`, which routes an `isViewFilterOrGroup` element to `viewFilterOrGroupToNode`, which lowers each member through `viewFilterRuleToNode` and returns `['or', ...nodes]`; `mergeFilterNodes` wraps the surviving sources in one `['and', ...]`. The server accepts the node: `packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts` `isFilterAST` admits `["and" | "or", ...children]`. Consumers reach that sink from `ListView.tsx` `buildEffectiveFilter` (through `mergeFilterNodes`), `ObjectView.tsx` (`mergeFilterNodes(authoredFilters.view || authoredFilters.table)`, and `toFilterNodeSafely` on the grid rung), `objectGridQueryInputs.ts` (`toFilterNodeSafely`), and the related-list, line-items, picker, lookup and element-data-source paths — every `filter` slot the describe is projected onto lowers through the one sink, so "the console applies it, ANDed with its sibling elements" is true of every nested-shape block the generated reference carries.
- "The console's filter builder edits a filter that is exactly one group as its OR logic, and saves its OR logic over two or more rules as one group" — true. `viewFilterFold.ts` `foldFilterGroupToSpecRules`: when `logic` is `'or'` and the rule count is greater than one it returns `{ ok: true, rules: [{ or: rules }] }`, otherwise the rules flat. `filter-converter.ts` `builderRulesOfSpecFilter`: a list with no group is AND, exactly one group is `{ logic: 'or', rules: only.or }`, anything else `null`.
- "a filter holding a group beside other elements is applied, and shown read-only in the builder rather than flattened on save (`builderRulesOfSpecFilter`)" — true. Applied: `toFilterNode` lowers the group in place regardless of its siblings. Read-only: `metadata-admin/widgets.tsx` `FilterBuilderField` sets `notEditable = shown === null` and the comment says "shown, never edited"; the pin is `viewFilterOrGroup.roundTrip-28370.test.tsx` (`filterOrGroupNotEditable` title). The runtime toolbar's `userFilterUrlState.ts` folds the user filter with `logic: 'and'` into URL state and never writes the stored view filter, so no second save path can flatten a mixed list.
- Note, no fix owed: for a group with ONE member, `viewFilterOrGroupToNode` returns that member's node bare (`nodes.length === 1 ? nodes[0] : ['or', ...nodes]`), so "one `or` node" is literal only for two or more members. The rows selected are identical, which is what the sentence is read for.
- The describe keeps "the list still ANDs every element" and the two-rule example, both still true; the new closing sentence makes the one claim the card asked for and no wider one.

**`packages/spec/src/ui/filter-rule-array.ts` — holds, with the scenario it is accepted against half-met in the package. One must-fix.**

- The hunk itself is right: the refusal keeps naming the any-of group element as the spelling of `$or` over flat rules, drops the "(declared, but no console applies it yet, so it does not narrow the rows today)" status, and its code comment no longer cites a PLANNED note. The guidance test re-pins the sentence.
- **Must-fix — `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` L13930–13931 (`dollarKeysReason`) still states the same false status in the same words' sibling form: "(declared, not yet applied by any console)".** This is the TODO reason the ADR-0087 record-form filter conversion writes for an author whose stored MongoDB-form filter carries `$or` — the very author and the very `$or` shape the card's filing gate names ("who writes a MongoDB-form `$or` and gets the parse refusal"), met one step earlier on the migration path instead of at the parse. The file is tracked, lives under `packages/spec/src` and ships in `dist`; the wording was introduced in `efb1620c`, the tree the card was filed against, so it was present when the card named its two sites; no test pins it (one occurrence in the whole head). After this PR the package tells the same author, on one path, that the group is live and, on the other, that no console applies it. The scenario the hits are accepted against — the `$or` refusal no longer points authors away from the shape that works — therefore does not hold across the package the spec lane owns. The PR's acceptance note reports a sweep for "the marker and the old sentences" that found nothing; the tree contradicts it because this copy is worded differently, not because it is absent. Remedy: delete the parenthetical "(declared, not yet applied by any console)" in `dollarKeysReason` (two words of prose), and pin it in the registry's conversion test if one asserts that reason text. This is a FAIL under the rule that a must-fix in ④ is a FAIL; the hits files themselves need no further change.

**Not judged here**: `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts` L173 ("Flat rules only: the any-of group element `ListView.filter` takes is deliberately NOT admitted here") describes the blueprint's own narrower accept-set, not the group's console status, and is correct as written. `view.zod.ts` L2303's "planned marker on its describe" belongs to a different key.

Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbWR3K3h7i1ytwycVg1`

**VERDICT: FAIL**
